name: data-modeling-inmon
description: Inmon/3NF methodology gate for the data-modeling role: when a proposal or record names Inmon/3NF as the chosen methodology, enforces the normalization-specific content (intended normalization target form in proposals, stated normalization deviations or an explicit no-deviations statement in records). Silent no-op when Inmon/3NF wasn't the methodology picked; the always-on data-modeling-structure gate already requires some methodology-fit token to be present.
